text:
Ivy (PM): Quick kickoff: launching a 6-week pilot called "Anchorboard" to validate Private onboarding flows, per-route observability, and partner-driven rollout gating. Target: 3 partners (2 startups, 1 regulated). Need: acceptance gates, outreach approach, light incentives, and a simple feedback loop.
Ramon (Solutions): Love the name. Suggest make onboarding time a hard gate: working inference within 5 business days. That forces us to simplify quickstart.
Claire (Infra): We can reserve a pilot pool (2GPUs/partner) for weeks 2-5. Need partner commit dates to block. We'll provide a sandbox domain `https://pilot-pvt.redwood` and ephemeral credentials.
Ben (Eng): We'll ship a tiny quickstart repo with: `examples/quickstart.sh`, a sample `docker-compose` and a harness for baseline runs. I'll own it.
Zoe (Design): We should collect both quantitative and short qualitative signals. Propose a 3-question weekly pulse: "setup friction (1-5)", "observability clarity (1-5)", "top friction (one line)". I'll draft.
Ivy (PM): Draft acceptance criteria proposal:
- Legal: lightweight NDA signed; DPA if partner traffic contains regulated data
- Onboarding: reproducible inference call within 5 business days using quickstart
- Observability: per-route 95p latency and token-cost visible in Console by day 10
- Quality: partner-provided eval set executed weekly; no >10% regression vs partner baseline
- Ops: partner agrees to at least two scheduled perf windows and to pass a trace-id header in requests
Ramon (Solutions): Incentives: 1) waived infra charges for pilot; 2) 6 hours Solutions/Eng credit (bookable slots); 3) optional co-marketing writeup for one signal partner.
Claire (Infra): Rollback plan: if error-rate >3% for 48h or 95p latency >SLO*2, revert to hosted fallback and schedule incident review. We'll document the steps in runbook.
Ben (Eng): Quickstart snippet for intake doc:
```
export RW_PILOT_URL=https://pilot-pvt.redwood
export RW_KEY=REDACTED
curl -s -X POST $RW_PILOT_URL/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -d '{"model":"mosaic-4b","input":"ping"}'
```
Ivy (PM): Recruitment cadence: Ramon to curate invites from customers in Private/Dedicated discussions; open intake form after 72h if spots remain. Prioritize teams with an eval set ready.
Zoe (Design): UX tasks: 1) first-run quickstart, 2) observability readout, 3) running the eval harness. Each task has a 1-2 question micro-survey. I'll post the Notion template.
Ramon (Solutions): Intake form should ask: contact, infra windows, can-share-eval (Y/N), data sensitivity level, and desired outcomes. Also capture "willing to co-market" checkbox.
sec-bot: Reminder: Security questionnaire required before issuing keys. If partner will send regulated data, DPA + additional controls required.
Ivy (PM): Feedback loop: weekly async pulse + one 30m review call mid-pilot + final wrap with product/eng. Keep asks minimal to encourage participation.
Claire (Infra): Perf windows: propose Tue/Thu 9-11am PT. We'll supply a generator: `python tools/load.py --count 300 --route /v1/generate` and a monitoring dashboard link.
Ben (Eng): We'll maintain a changelog in the repo and tag commits with `pilot/anchorboard`. Also add a `harness/compare.py` script partners can run to compare outputs.
Ivy (PM): Success metrics to evaluate pilot: 1) 80% of partners meet onboarding gate in 5 days, 2) average feedback pulse >=4/5, 3) at least one partner expresses intent to convert to Dedicated or Private in 90 days.
Ramon (Solutions): Outreach plan: seed 6 invites, expect 3-4 accept; follow up after 48h. Use direct channel first.
Zoe (Design): I'll tag qualitative notes with labels: "setup", "observability", "quality" so we can prioritize UX fixes.
Ivy (PM): Action items and owners: Ramon: draft outreach + intake form (48h); Ben: quickstart repo + harness (48h); Claire: capacity calendar + perf windows (48h); Zoe: pulse + Notion template (24h); sec-bot/Legal: confirm NDA/DPA path (48h); Ivy: publish pilot brief + selection rubric (72h).
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 48 hours to track deliverables.
Ivy (PM): One open question: do we allow partners to opt into limited A/B of suggestions (e.g., batching) in shadow mode? Thoughts?
Ben (Eng): I'd allow shadow-only experiments (no autopilot) with explicit opt-in. We can mirror traffic and surface suggested deltas. Safer.
Ramon (Solutions): Good compromise. capture in intake form whether partner is comfortable with shadow experiments.
Ivy (PM): OK. I'll finalize the Notion brief and send invites tomorrow morning. Thanks all :sparkles:
